description: Reimplement all three stores (users, books, reviews) with Supabase-backed implementations behind the UNCHANGED existing interfaces, selecting the backend at store-construction time: use Supabase when isSupabaseConfigured() is true, otherwise fall back to the EXISTING in-memory implementations (which must be kept). Add pure-function row<->object mappers with dedicated unit tests that run without a live DB. This fixes the 'User not found.' bug (in-memory user store empty on a fresh serverless isolate) by making persistence durable. Depends on FEAT-001 (Supabase client). No caller changes: interfaces are already async.
steps: Create pure mapper functions (e.g. in `src/lib/supabase/mappers.ts`) converting between camelCase domain objects and snake_case DB rows, with NO Supabase calls so they are unit-testable in isolation. Users: StoredUser {id,email,passwordHash,learningProfile?,createdAt} <-> users row {id,email,password_hash,learning_profile,created_at}. Books: StoredBook {bookId,userId,meta,text,chunks,createdAt,curriculum?,analysis?,questions?,analyzedAt?} <-> books row {book_id,user_id,meta,text,chunks,created_at,curriculum,analysis,questions,analyzed_at}. Reviews: ReviewDeck {userId,bookId,cards} <-> review_decks row {user_id,book_id,cards}. Handle null vs undefined correctly: DB null optional columns map to absent/undefined on the object (do NOT set learningProfile/curriculum/analysis/questions/analyzedAt when the column is null); when writing, omit or send null for absent optionals. created_at/analyzed_at are bigint in DB: ensure they round-trip as JS numbers (Number()).

In `src/lib/store/users.ts`: keep InMemoryUserStore and all existing exports (normalizeEmail, generateUserId, getUserStore, UserStore, StoredUser). Add a SupabaseUserStore implementing UserStore using getSupabaseAdmin(): create -> insert mapped row; getById -> select by id (single, treat not-found as undefined); getByEmail -> select by normalizeEmail(email) (email stored already-normalized at create time; normalize on lookup too); saveProfile(id,profile) -> update learning_profile where id=id and return the updated row, returning undefined when NO row matched (preserve the exact 'undefined if no such user' semantics that the onboarding route relies on for its 404). Use `.select()` on the update / check affected rows so a missing user yields undefined rather than a fabricated record. Select the singleton backend at construction: `isSupabaseConfigured() ? new SupabaseUserStore() : new InMemoryUserStore()`. Keep the globalThis HMR cache for non-production.

In `src/lib/store/index.ts` (BookStore): keep InMemoryBookStore and existing exports (getBookStore, generateBookId, BookStore, StoredBook, AnalysisResult). Add SupabaseBookStore: save -> upsert mapped row on book_id; get(bookId,userId) -> select where book_id=bookId AND user_id=userId (returns undefined when missing OR not owned - enforce ownership in the query, not just client-side); list(userId) -> select where user_id=userId order by created_at desc (most recent first); saveAnalysis(bookId,userId,result) -> update curriculum/analysis/questions/analyzed_at (Date.now()) where book_id=bookId AND user_id=userId, returning the updated row or undefined when no owned row matched. Select backend at construction like the user store; keep globalThis HMR cache.

In `src/lib/store/reviews.ts` (ReviewStore): keep InMemoryReviewStore and existing exports (getReviewStore, ReviewStore, ReviewCard, ReviewDeck). Add SupabaseReviewStore: getDeck(userId,bookId) -> select where user_id=userId AND book_id=bookId (undefined when none); saveDeck(deck) -> upsert mapped row on composite pk (user_id, book_id). Select backend at construction; keep globalThis HMR cache.

Add unit tests for the mappers as pure functions (e.g. `src/lib/supabase/__tests__/mappers.test.ts`) that run WITHOUT a live DB or any env vars. Cover, for each of the three entities: round-trip object->row->object equality; null optional columns map to undefined (absent) on the object and are not fabricated; bigint timestamp columns round-trip as numbers; email/user-id/book-id keys land in the correct snake_case columns. These tests must pass keyless.

Do NOT modify any route handler, page, or other caller. Do NOT change the existing interface signatures. Do NOT delete or alter the existing in-memory classes or the existing 79 tests (routeAuth.test.ts and session.test.ts seed the real in-memory singletons and must keep passing keyless).
acceptance_criteria: All three store modules export the exact same public API as before (same function/type names and signatures); no caller file is modified.
When SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are BOTH absent, get*Store() returns the in-memory implementation and all existing behavior is unchanged.
When both env vars are present, get*Store() returns the Supabase-backed implementation.

BookStore.get and saveAnalysis enforce ownership in the query (return undefined for a non-owner); UserStore.saveProfile returns undefined when the user row does not exist; BookStore.list returns most-recent-first.
Mapper unit tests exist and pass keyless, covering round-trip, null->undefined for optionals, and bigint->number for timestamps.
Existing 79 tests still pass; new mapper tests raise the total. Keyless `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` all pass.
No hardcoded Supabase keys; service_role key read only from env via the FEAT-001 client.

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run typecheck
